lines.q: Peanuts are not really nuts. So what are they?
lines.a: Legumes! They're related to peas and beans, and grow underground.

lines.q: Where did potatoes originally come from?
lines.a: Peru, in the Andes! Not Ireland. They only reached Europe in the fifteen hundreds.

lines.q: How long does it take to grow one pineapple?
lines.a: About two years! One plant usually gives just one fruit at a time. Bet you didn't expect that.

lines.q: Last one. Which spice is the most expensive in the world?
lines.a: Saffron! Each flower gives only three tiny threads, picked by hand. Think you can get all four? Go again!
